Corollary
[Limit set of a normal subgroup] 1. Corollary 8.1.3\group Kleinian groupsSource: thurston:page-0187 If $\Gamma $ is non-elementary and $1\neq \Gamma '\triangleleft \Gamma $, then $L_{\Gamma '}=L_\Gamma $.
Proof

\sketch Normality makes $L_{\Gamma '}$ invariant under $\Gamma $. The subgroup is infinite, so minimality gives $L_\Gamma \subseteq L_{\Gamma '}$; the reverse inclusion follows from orbit containment.

□
